name: Twilight Epoch
detailed_description:
As the Blight grows with each passing day, the worlds wither in turn. The drifting planes that still light the sky fade like embers, and the powers that live to see them covet dominion of the few centuries that remain. A young man from a distant plane is taken from his home, and fights to find peace, before all ends in silence.

Embark on an adventure through a mysterious science-fantasy galaxy, blending intense FPS action with the customization of a party-based RPG, across endlessly replayable levels of strange and sprawling worlds.

A GALACTIC JOURNEY

A campaign split into 3 books, with 20+ enormous levels to be explored and plundered, each handcrafted and fully unique with their own aesthetic, lore, and enemy roster.

Ancient temples, shadowy space piers, towering cities; all dense with loot, secrets, and deadly encounters.

BUILD YOUR PARTY

Swashbuckle and parry with dual cutlasses, rocket jump with a mecha arm cannon, battle as a knight in explosive armour, or just throw big rocks at people.

Use 6 characters, 100+ unique weapons across 18 types, plus a wide range combat abilities, passive-granting armours, and items that all make meaningful differences to your playstyle.

RAW COMBAT

Face off against 50 enemy types and 12 brutal bosses in combat combining bullet hell, hack-and-slash, and FPS.

Each encounter is a dangerous test of skill, while still open enough to allow expression and multiple strategies.

ENDLESS CHALLENGE

'Essence' from slain foes turns into 'shards', which are spent to unlock new power, but those same shards are your lives.

Time bonuses, enemy rank, grazing, and many other things give you more essence in a simple but deep scoring system, where the better you play, the more the game opens up.

UNCOVER THE PAST

Immerse yourself in a story inspired by classic pulp fantasy, equal parts mature and unhinged, telling a personal tale atop a brewing intrigue and an ancient tragedy.
